$comment: Golden cases of the safebox and mall password dialog (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py; P16 spec 5.4.5, 12): a modal with the safebox's title (localeInfo.PASSWORD_TITLE), legacy's five lines and the empty password field (mall: the mall's title, MALL_PASSWORD_TITLE); translucent: modern-dark and modern-light at 80% panel opacity over the synthetic backdrop. Its classic art is in assets/ETC. Frames: the modern and cyberpunk cases leave about 120dp beside the window's right and bottom edges, so its shadow fits the frame (nuitool's soft renderer stretches a frame's shadow texture, its background included, when the frame clips the shadow); classic keeps its frame of legacy's size.
